description: End-to-end telco CRM customer retention workflow: identify at-risk customers, design and simulate offers, obtain approvals, execute retention actions, and track outcomes with rollback and retry capabilities.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for a telco customer in the CRM system

account_id.description: Billing or service account identifier associated with one or more services

retention_case_id.description: Identifier for a specific retention workflow instance opened for a customer

offer_id.description: Identifier of a predefined commercial retention offer template

offer_proposal_id.description: Identifier of a tailored offer proposal generated for a specific case

campaign_id.description: Identifier of a marketing/retention campaign context

interaction_id.description: Identifier for a logged contact center or digital interaction

task_id.description: Identifier for a follow-up or operational task created as part of the retention workflow

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: identify_at_risk_customers
functions.description: Run churn risk detection to identify at-risk customers and optionally open retention cases.

segment_filters.description: Filters that define the customer segment to scan for churn risk.

markets.description: Market or country codes to include.

include_campaign_ids.description: Only include customers targeted in these campaigns.

exclude_customer_ids.description: Explicitly exclude specific customers from detection.

risk_threshold.description: Minimum churn risk score (0-1) for a customer to be considered at risk.

run_mode.description: Whether to only simulate results or actually open retention cases.

auto_create_case.description: If true and run_mode is 'execute', retention cases will be created for at-risk customers.

default_owner_team.description: Team identifier to own newly created retention cases.

priority_mapping.description: Mapping from risk score ranges to case priority.

pagination.description: Pagination controls for scanning large customer sets.

functions.returns: Summary of at-risk customers, their risk scores, and any retention_case_ids created when run_mode is 'execute'.

functions.name: create_retention_case
functions.description: Create a new retention case for a specific customer, capturing churn signals and context.

source.description: Entry point that triggered this case.

initial_signals.description: Observed churn indicators at the time of case creation.

campaign_id.description: If case is related to a specific campaign.

functions.returns: Retention case record including retention_case_id, status, and assigned owner/team.

functions.name: get_retention_case
functions.description: Retrieve details of a retention case including customer context, interactions, and offers.

include.description: Additional related entities to expand in the response.

functions.returns: Full retention case details with optional expansions of related entities.

functions.name: analyze_churn_risk
functions.description: Run a detailed churn risk analysis for a customer or specific retention case, producing drivers and recommendations.

analysis_scope.description: Scope of data considered for analysis.

what_if_scenarios.description: Optional what-if scenarios to simulate risk impact of potential changes.

changes.description: List of hypothetical changes applied in this scenario.

functions.returns: Current churn risk score, top contributing drivers, and optional what-if scenario results and recommendations.

functions.name: search_retention_offers
functions.description: Search available retention offer templates suitable for a given customer or case context.

filters.description: Filter criteria for narrowing down applicable offers.

max_discount_percentage.description: Maximum total discount allowed in percent.

min_margin_impact.description: Minimum expected monthly margin delta (negative means lower margin).

limit.description: Maximum number of offer templates to return.

functions.returns: List of candidate offer templates with predicted uplift, margin impact, and applicability explanations.

functions.name: simulate_offer_impact
functions.description: Simulate financial and churn impact of one or more specific offers for a given retention case.

offers.description: Set of offers (by template or already proposed) to be simulated.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides to default offer parameters for simulation only.

time_horizon_months.description: Time horizon for financial impact simulation.

include_sensitivity_analysis.description: If true, run sensitivity analysis across risk and acceptance probabilities.

functions.returns: Per-offer simulation results including predicted churn reduction, NPV impact, and sensitivity ranges.

functions.name: create_offer_proposal
functions.description: Create a tailored offer proposal for a specific retention case, optionally bundling multiple components.

base_offer_id.description: Primary offer template used as the base of this proposal.

components.description: Detailed list of offer components composing the proposal.

requires_approval.description: Whether this proposal must go through an approval workflow before being presented.

notes_for_agent.description: Internal guidance for the agent presenting this offer to the customer.

functions.returns: Created offer proposal with offer_proposal_id, status (draft/pending_approval/approved), and high-level impact estimates.

functions.name: update_retention_case_status
functions.description: Update the status, owner, and attributes of a retention case, including escalation and closure.

updates.description: Fields to update on the retention case.

resolution.description: Resolution details to be set at case closure.

reason.description: Business reason for the status change or update.

performed_by.description: User or system identifier initiating the update.

functions.returns: Updated retention case snapshot including new status, owner, and timestamps.

functions.name: present_offer_to_customer
functions.description: Log the presentation of an offer proposal to the customer and capture their decision or pending status.

interaction_details.description: Details about the interaction in which the offer was presented.

customer_decision.description: Outcome of the offer presentation, if already known.

reason_code.description: Standardized rejection or pending reason code.

functions.returns: Recorded interaction event, updated offer_proposal status, and potentially updated retention case status.

functions.name: execute_retention_actions
functions.description: Execute the operational changes required by an accepted offer, with support for partial failures and rollback.

requested_actions.description: Optional subset of actions to execute; if omitted, all required actions will be executed.

idempotency_key.description: Key to ensure repeated calls do not duplicate side effects.

functions.returns: Execution job details including per-action status, any errors, and rollback tokens for recovery if supported.

functions.name: rollback_retention_actions
functions.description: Rollback previously executed retention actions for a case when execution fails or is cancelled.

rollback_token.description: Token or reference produced by execute_retention_actions enabling a consistent rollback.

actions_to_rollback.description: Specific action IDs or types to rollback when scope is 'specified_actions'.

functions.returns: Rollback operation result with per-action rollback status, residual inconsistencies, and updated case state.

functions.name: retry_retention_execution
functions.description: Retry failed or pending retention execution steps for a case with optional adjustments.

previous_execution_id.description: Identifier of the previous execution job whose failures should be retried.

retry_strategy.description: Controls which parts of the previous execution are retried.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides for retried actions (e.g., different device SKU).

functions.returns: New execution attempt details including mapping to previous actions and their updated statuses.

functions.name: cancel_retention_case
functions.description: Cancel an ongoing retention case before completion, with impact analysis and optional automatic tasks.

create_follow_up_task.description: Whether to create a follow-up task (e.g., to monitor the account after cancellation).

follow_up_task_details.description: Details for an optional follow-up task created on cancellation.

functions.returns: Confirmation of case cancellation, final status, and any created follow-up task_id.

functions.name: search_customers
functions.description: Faceted search across customer records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for telco_customer_retention_workflow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of customer records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_customers_by_status
functions.description: List customer records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of customer records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_customer_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single customer record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A customer record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_customers
functions.description: Submit a batch of customer records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_customers
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many customer records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_customers
functions.description: Soft-archive customer records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_customers
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of customer records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for customer lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created customer event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_customer_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a customer including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_customer_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for telco_customer_retention_workflow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_customer_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a telco_customer_retention_workflow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_customer_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled telco_customer_retention_workflow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_customer_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a telco_customer_retention_workflow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_customer_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a customer prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_customer_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a customer for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_customer_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending customer approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_customer
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached customer to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_customer_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a customer.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_customer_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a customer with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_customer_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a customer and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_customer_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a customer (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_customer_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for telco_customer_retention_workflow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_customer_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for telco_customer_retention_workflow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_customer_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed telco_customer_retention_workflow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_customer_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active telco_customer_retention_workflow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_customer_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a customer and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
